title: Crimson Desert sells 3 million copies in 5 days as Pearl Abyss pledges content roadmap
content: Pearl Abyss's Crimson Desert has reached 3 million units sold within five days of launch, building on its 2 million in 24-hour milestone. Pearl Abyss has pledged an ongoing content roadmap and rapid patch cadence following player feedback on launch-day performance issues on Intel GPUs and control scheme concerns.
